grouping_principles: parameters use a similar optimization mechanism
parameters respond to similar workload signals
explicit parent-child and mutual-exclusion dependencies stay together
parameters are suitable for joint validation in one probe experiment

memory_excluded_parameters.name: kv_cache_memory_bytes
memory_excluded_parameters.reason: kv_cache_memory_bytes explicitly overrides gpu_memory_utilization, so jointly sampling both would create an inactive dimension. The current SCOOT BO implements gpu_memory_utilization, whose fractional domain remains meaningful across the searched TP/DP, quantization, and KV-dtype branches; absolute per-GPU bytes would require branch-specific bounds.

groups.title: Model Representation and Numeric Quality
groups.optimization_mechanism: Affects model arithmetic precision, memory footprint, and trade-off between throughput and output quality through quantization and model implementation choice.
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: Varying dtype, quantization, and model_impl together explores combined effects on memory, computation, and quality. A single trial can exercise a full model configuration template.

groups.title: Parallel Topology and GPU Communication
groups.optimization_mechanism: Controls how the model is partitioned across GPUs and the backend for data parallel synchronization, affecting inter-GPU communication, per-GPU memory usage, and batch distribution.
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: These parameters collectively define the parallel topology. Jointly varying tensor/data parallel sizes and their associated options allows the optimizer to find the best configuration that satisfies GPU count constraint and workload characteristics.

groups.title: KV Cache Sizing and Precision
groups.optimization_mechanism: Controls KV cache memory budget, block granularity, and data type precision, directly influencing KV cache capacity and memory pressure.
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: Tuning these parameters together explores trade-offs between memory consumption and performance, as max_model_len defines the maximum context, gpu_memory_utilization sets the budget, and block_size/kv_cache_dtype affect cache efficiency.

groups.title: vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching
groups.optimization_mechanism: Enables reuse of KV cache blocks for repeated prompt prefixes, reducing redundant computation. Hash algorithm affects cache lookup fidelity and overhead.
internal_dependencies: prefix_caching_hash_algo active only when enable_prefix_caching == true
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: Enabling prefix caching and choosing the hash algorithm are naturally tested together; the hash choice only matters when caching is on, and a joint experiment can measure the impact on reuse and performance.

groups.title: CacheBlend (LMCache-based) Features
groups.optimization_mechanism: Enables and configures LMCache-based blending, which trades off between recomputation and reuse of cached KV states across requests, affecting latency, throughput, and output quality.
internal_dependencies: cacheblend_allow_prefix_caching, lmcache_chunk_size, cacheblend_blend_min_tokens, cacheblend_blend_check_layers, cacheblend_blend_recompute_ratios all require cacheblend_mode == on
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: All CacheBlend parameters are gated by cacheblend_mode; jointly varying them in a single experiment ensures consistent evaluation of the CacheBlend feature branch, including coexistence with prefix caching.

groups.title: Speculative Decoding Configuration
groups.optimization_mechanism: Enables speculative decoding using n-gram prediction to propose multiple tokens per step, aiming to improve throughput at the cost of added verification work.
internal_dependencies: num_speculative_tokens active only when speculative_method == ngram
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: The speculative method and the number of speculative tokens are inherently coupled; a joint experiment can explore the trade-off between speed and acceptance rate.

groups.title: Scheduler and Batch Control
groups.optimization_mechanism: Controls request admission, batching limits, handling of long prefills, and asynchronous scheduling to balance GPU utilization and latency.
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: These parameters together shape the scheduling behavior; varying them in a joint experiment allows the optimizer to find the best combination of batching and admission strategies under the given workload.

groups.title: Execution and Kernel Optimizations
groups.optimization_mechanism: Toggles CUDA graph usage, cascade attention kernel, and FlashInfer autotuning, influencing compute graph overhead and kernel performance.
groups.joint_experiment_rationale: Jointly testing these execution-related flags provides a comprehensive picture of kernel and graph optimization impacts on performance and stability.

cross_group_dependencies.reason: cacheblend_allow_prefix_caching from CacheBlend group determines whether vLLM's enable_prefix_caching (from prefix_caching group) may be active when CacheBlend is on; the effective prefix caching is a logical AND of both gates.

grouping_notes: CacheBlend and speculative decoding groups are conditional; all others are core.
Parallel topology group includes parameters that activate only under specific parallel sizes, but the group represents the overall topology search dimension.
Scheduler group assumes chunked_prefill is enabled (scenario fixed), so all parameters are always active.
No explicit cross-parameter dependencies exist between model representation and other groups.
disable_cascade_attn and enforce_eager have known interaction (cascade_attn requires CUDA graphs), but they are not parent-child, so placed in execution group together.
